metadata.title: Hard Rock Band Portrait with Geometric Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: Use for high-contrast monochrome band portraits featuring ultra-bold, geometric display lettering that overlaps the subject.
excludeWhen: minimalist or thin typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white composition featuring three male faces in a tight, overlapping arrangement, anchored by a massive, white geometric display font in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography overlaps the hair of the leftmost subject
Faces are arranged in a diagonal recession from left to right
Deep shadows merge the subjects into a solid black background
High-key white text contrasts against dark hair and shadows
coreInvariants: Monochrome black and white color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three faces occupy the majority of the frame, scaled to fill the vertical space with varying degrees of overlap.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white text block in the top-left corner acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright text, follows the diagonal line of the faces downward and to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the lower half and between the subjects creates a sense of depth and mystery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for background and shadows
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for typography and highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and hair detail
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Letters are tightly kerned to the point of touching or overlapping
Horizontal bars are thin compared to vertical stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a very low crossbar and a flat top
The 'E' and 'B' have extremely compressed internal spaces

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical weight and density.
Captures the geometric essence of the letterforms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of three men's faces overlapping in a diagonal arrangement, using chiaroscuro lighting with deep shadows and bright highlights on skin and hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in the top-left corner using an ultra-bold, white geometric sans-serif font. The letters should be tightly packed and slightly overlap the hair of the subject on the left.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the typography ultra-bold and geometric?
Do the faces overlap with deep shadow transitions?
Is the text positioned in the top-left corner?

mustRedesign: Ensure the faces are generic and not recognizable celebrities

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of subjects into the black background

postGenerationChecks: Verify text is pure white with no transparency
Ensure no color artifacts are present
Confirm typography is the largest graphic element
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome photography + Overlapping subjects + Ultra-bold geometric display type in top-left corner.
